_comment: Pinned Android build toolchain for LEIA. Build scripts refuse to run if the machine does not match. Contains no secrets.

gradle._resources_note: Build machine: 8 logical CPUs, 7.9 GB RAM. Default parallelism exhausted virtual memory on 2026-11-25 (clang crashes, 'Insufficient system resources', Windows event 2004). The only successful build (2026-11-24) used --max-workers=2 and in-process Kotlin.

android_sdk._additional_note: AGP for compileSdk 37 also requires build-tools 37.0.0 (2026-11-23 failure: 'Failed to install build-tools;37.0.0').

customer._forbidden_note: Pulled in by androidx.biometric via expo-secure-store; LEIA never uses requireAuthentication or biometrics (blocked in frontend/app.json).

signing._debug_note: Public React Native template debug key. Both installed demos use it. Staging-only; anyone can sign with it.
signing._release_note: Release signing uses a SEPARATE key per app: apps.<app>.release_cert_sha256. Since vc3 (2026-11-28) the keys are Expo-managed (EAS credentials for @pardhu_m9_t/leia-customer and leia-agent-crm, owner-approved); the owner keeps an encrypted offline backup. Only public certificate fingerprints are recorded here. signing.release_cert_sha256 is unused and must stay null.
